# Third-party dependencies and modified overlays

The complete upstream FAST-LIO, EGO-Planner and Fast-Drone-250 repositories are intentionally **not vendored** here.

`fast-drone-250-modifications/` contains only the project-specific modified/new files recovered from the deployed workspace. Treat these files as an overlay on top of the upstream ZJU-FAST-Lab Fast-Drone-250 / EGO-Planner stack. See `docs/EGO_PLANNER_MODIFICATIONS.md` for attribution and the confirmed changes.

The exact upstream commit used by the original deployment was not preserved, so this repository does not invent a base commit hash.
